description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

title.zh: 查询网站业务的请求来源省份分布
title.en: Query request source province distribution for website services

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-view-source-provinces --resource-group-id default --start-time 1582992000 --end-time 1583683200 --domain www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
